_doc: r32 mechanism registry (artifacts/dero-game-theory-rft.md §4, §9). GO = built as a DVM-BASIC contract, executed in the DVM (dvm/r32_gametheory_test.go), modelled in harness/gametheory/econsim.py and run by playbooks/gt_playbook.py. NO-GO = rejected with the reason; never re-proposed without new evidence. D-GT-3: a smart contract cannot change the protocol block reward, and no DVM builtin exposes the block's miner or integrator (harness/gametheory/gt_pipeline.py discovery stage).

mechanisms.name: Miner-attested token (MAT): optimistic bonded claim, challenge, commit-reveal jurors
mechanisms.equilibrium: Truthful claiming is the attractor iff bond > (1-c) * reward * v / c per miniblock, c = P(challenge) * P(jury correct) (econsim m1_critical_bond, replicator). Jurors: coherent voting earns a share of the loser's bond plus slashed stakes; incoherent or unrevealed jurors lose ceil(slash %) of their stake (Schelling point). R33: a juror's whole free stake is escrowed per dispute at CommitVote (GT-A02), so one stake backs one open dispute; the coherent jurors' pot is the losing side's unpaid bond plus floor(slash %) of the incoherent escrow, never more than the loser escrowed.
mechanisms.sustainability: MAT is issued, not bought: its value is what fee payers and sponsors in M2/M3 pay for the boost. Bonds and slashes are zero-sum inside one dispute. Needs at least one honest verifier-challenger and juror participation. R33 GT-A07: up to 8 challengers per claim until claim height + window; an undecided dispute (yes == no, including no reveal) refunds every bond and mints nothing. Slashes no coherent juror can claim and floor remainders go to an owner-withdrawable treasury (GT-A13).
attacks: sybil: a miner may split into many addresses; claims are per address and per height range, so splitting gains nothing
collusion / P+epsilon bribe of jurors (econsim m1_bribe_cost); mitigation: commit-reveal, slashing, stake caps; residual risk stated
griefing: a challenger loses its bond to an upheld honest claim
front-running / copying: votes are committed as sha256(i:vote:salt:ADDRESS_STRING(SIGNER())) (R33 GT-A08), so a copied commit cannot be revealed; claims and challenges are public by design
gas DoS: every entrypoint O(1) except Finalize, which loops over at most maxch = 8 challengers

R33 GT-A09 (design, residual): an unchallenged claim mints after `window` blocks; MAT integrity needs a watcher online within every window. The contract default (20) is a test value: deployments set window >= 200 blocks (playbooks mainnet: 200, ~1 h); SetParams bounds window/commitw/revealw to <= 10^6.

R33 GT-A17 (design, residual): the DVM cannot read block headers, so a claim is not bound to real mining; any address (incl. Sybils) may claim any past range. The only defence is the bonded challenge plus honest jurors (GT-A02/A07/A08 make that defence sound); bribed or Sybil juror majorities remain a stated risk.

R33 GT-A01/A12/A13/A15: Initialize runs once and never anonymously; no-deposit entrypoints refuse DERO; bond <= 10^12, reward <= 10^6, maxmb <= 100, minstake in (0, maxstake]; juror payout uses an exact product when it fits in 64 bits, else a 10^-6 scaled share.
mechanisms.observable: the claim is checked OFF-chain against public block headers (DERO.GetBlock miners list); the DVM cannot read it

mechanisms.name: Useful service (notary) with a bounded fee rebate and a MAT boost
mechanisms.equilibrium: No profitable wash trading iff rho * (100 + boost) <= 10000 (enforced in SetParams; econsim m2_wash_profitable grid). A sponsor subsidy S is a Tullock contest: equilibrium fee spend X* = S (n-1) / (n (1-rho)); the subsidy is dissipated, a fraction (n-1)/n going to the treasury as fees.
mechanisms.sustainability: Rebates come only from the same epoch's fees and sponsor funds; pools close at the epoch end. A sponsor buys activity, not organic demand: subsidised activity must be reported as subsidised (NO-GO N3). R33 GT-A10: a pool whose epoch ended with no fee payer rolls into the next epoch with a Notarize or Sponsor call (R<e> records the target); Sponsor needs Freeze. The floor remainder of an epoch's rebates goes to the treasury with its last claim (GT-A13).
attacks: wash trading (bounded as above)
MAT recycling across addresses: locked until the epoch end

first-writer-wins front-running of a document digest: the digest is public once sent (residual); R33 GT-A16 stores the submitter (by<doc>) next to the height (d<doc>), so the record shows who notarized

R33 GT-A01/A12/A13/A15: Initialize runs once and never anonymously; no-deposit entrypoints refuse DERO; fee <= 10^12, boost <= 1000, epoch <= 10^7; rebate = exact pool*w/W when it fits in 64 bits, else a 10^-5 scaled share

mechanisms.name: No-loss prize pool with a commit-reveal draw and a MAT boost
mechanisms.equilibrium: Entry EV = prize * w / W - entry fee - tx fees >= 0 (principal and, if revealed, the reveal bond are returned); the MAT boost doubles a miner's weight. R33 GT-A05: a forfeited reveal bond goes to the treasury, never into the prize, so withholding k reveals costs k * rbond for at most the prize: unprofitable while prize <= rbond (a Sybil with k entries chooses among 2^k outcomes, so the bound is per withheld reveal, not rbond * (n-1)); deployments keep rbond >= the expected prize. R33 GT-A06: every entry pays a non-refundable fee (SetFees, default 1000) to the treasury and a principal >= minp (default 1000); a Sybil fill of maxn slots is unprofitable iff maxn * fee >= the prize. v2 (D-GT-10) draws from the revealed seed only: v1 mixed RANDOM (keyed by the block id), which let the Draw block's integrator withhold the block to re-roll at the cost of one integrator share (3,075 atomic on mainnet today); econsim m3_withholding.
mechanisms.sustainability: Prizes are sponsor funds only (R33 GT-A05). Forfeited reveal bonds and entry fees go to an owner-withdrawable treasury; never another participant's principal.
attacks: last-revealer withholding: bounded by rbond per withheld reveal, the forfeit leaves the round (R33 GT-A05)
v1 only: integrator block withholding to re-roll RANDOM (removed in v2)

reveal censorship (R33 GT-A14, design, residual): an integrator can leave a reveal tx out of its block, but the reveal window spans many blocks and integrators (12 distinct integrators in 60 live blocks, reward_analysis); the forfeited bond goes to the treasury, not to the censor's round; deployments size revealw from the measured confirmation latency (playbooks), bounded <= 10^6
gas DoS: maxn <= 64 entries per round, the v2 Draw loop measured at 1,774,800 compute gas for 32 entries of the 10,000,000 limit

R33 GT-A01/A12/A13/A15: Initialize runs once and never anonymously; no-deposit entrypoints refuse DERO; rbond, fee, minp <= 10^12, boost <= 1000; a copied prize commit only gives the copier the same reveal option every entrant has (commit not address-bound, unchanged)

mechanisms.name: Audit bounty: paid independent detection over public chain data (headers, emission)
mechanisms.equilibrium: Honest auditing pays iff bounty / winners > the auditor's fees (econsim m4_auditor_ev); a lazy guess or a copied commit forfeits the bond (the commit is bound to ADDRESS_STRING(SIGNER())). R33 GT-A04: auditors whose answer equals the sponsor's revealed answer share the bounty only if no revealed answer differs; any differing answer sets disputed=1 (public detection signal), refunds every bond and returns the bounty to the sponsor (Reclaim). A majority never overrides the sponsor and never slashes a minority: Sybils can grief (dispute) but never profit. NOT prevented: collusion or bribery, a single entrant's grief-dispute.
mechanisms.research: scratchpad r32a research_web.md Q3-Q4 (Truebit verifier's dilemma, Chainlink alert bounty, supply turnstiles); security_inventory.md groups 1-2 (detection only: a contract cannot verify consensus or see value an unsound proof created)
mechanisms.sustainability: Bounties are the sponsor's own funds per round plus bonds forfeited by non-revealers and remainders (a rollover, 'carry', funded by earlier rounds); never another participant's bond or a later deposit (econsim ledger_m4, stop-inflow PASS). A disputed or sponsor-withheld round refunds every bond and returns the bounty to the sponsor (R33 GT-A04). An honest auditor gains iff bounty / winners exceeds its own fees (econsim M4 checks).
attacks: Copying a commit: refused, the commit is bound to ADDRESS_STRING(SIGNER()) and Reveal recomputes it (DVM test CopyAttack).
Lazy guessing: a 64-hex digest cannot be guessed; a non-revealer forfeits its bond; a wrong revealed answer disputes the round (refund, no profit; R33 GT-A04).
Sponsor withholding: every bond is refunded (refund=1); the bounty returns to the sponsor only after the timeout (SponsorNoReveal).
Sybil majority against a revealed sponsor answer (R33 GT-A04): disputed=1, every bond refunded, bounty back to the sponsor; the Sybils gain nothing (TestR33AuditA04SybilMajority).

Gas / storage-gas lock (R33 GT-A03): answers are 1..256 bytes and tallied per HEX(SHA3256(answer)) at Reveal; Settle is O(n), measured 3.1M compute gas at maxn = 32 (TestR33AuditA03SettleLineLimit). A round never settled times out at start + commitw + revealw + tmo (2000): entrants pull their bonds back with Withdraw, the sponsor the bounty with Reclaim.
NOT prevented: collusion or bribery among auditors who all repeat a wrong sponsor answer; any single entrant can force a dispute (grief, at the cost of its locked bond and fees).
R33 GT-A01/A12/A13/A15: Initialize runs once and never anonymously; no-deposit entrypoints refuse DERO; bond <= 10^12, windows <= 10^6, maxn <= 32.

mechanisms.name: Referral pyramid / pay-earlier-from-later deposits (M-NOGO-1)
mechanisms.reason: Ponzi-shaped: every return is funded by a later participant's deposit (econsim stop_inflow_check flags it; planted positive of the PONZI check).

mechanisms.name: SC-native proof-of-work faucet (sha256 nonce bound to SIGNER)
mechanisms.reason: It proves hashing, but hashing diverted from AstroBWT mining lowers network hashrate: the opposite of the goal.

mechanisms.name: Marketing subsidised SC activity as organic usage
mechanisms.reason: Misleading to third parties: M2 sponsor-funded activity is dissipated subsidy (Tullock), not demand.

mechanisms.name: A contract that raises or redirects the protocol block reward
mechanisms.reason: Infeasible and consensus: the reward is CalcBlockReward(height) in blockchain code (harness/gametheory/reward_anchors.json); a DVM contract can only send DERO it holds (D-GT-3, D-21).

mechanisms.name: Emission-funded yield / liquidity mining paid in a freshly minted token with promised returns
mechanisms.reason: Value comes only from later buyers; documented collapse when programs end (gametheory/research/dossier.md, design implication 8).

mechanisms.name: Quadratic funding without sybil resistance
mechanisms.reason: DERO accounts are anonymous and cheap to register; QF's identity assumption fails (dossier implication 9).

mechanisms.name: Orphan-insurance contract (pay miners for orphaned miniblocks)
mechanisms.reason: Research Q5 (gametheory/research/r32a_research_web.md): Ethereum's uncle rewards lowered the selfish-mining profit threshold from 0.25 to about 0.185; paying for orphans subsidises withholding, the attack it would seem to insure against.

mechanisms.name: Superlinear loyalty / streak bonuses, or a stipend per identity
mechanisms.reason: Research Q1 (pool-payout game theory): consensus already pays linearly per accepted miniblock; a superlinear or streak bonus rewards consolidation, and a per-identity stipend rewards Sybil identities. The R32a claim is linear per accepted miniblock (D-GT-13).

mechanisms.name: verified mining pool
mechanisms.equilibrium: mining for a member is verified in-contract (anchored BLID + SHA3256 of the block bytes + the miniblock Flags tag), so credit needs real accepted work; W_i = w_i(1 + min(s_i/S, 1)) is linear in work and never gains from splitting work or stake (dvm/r33_pool_test.go TestR33PoolSplitNeutral); a share cap bounds any one member
mechanisms.observable: GetSC: burned, P<e>, TW<e>, W<e>_<tag>, w<e>_<tag>, c<e>_<tag>, t<h>, k/kn/km census per epoch
mechanisms.sustainability: paid from sponsor Fund deposits and entry fees; beta % of every inflow is burned (locked, no exit); the prover fee is paid only for blocks that credit a member
attacks: tag forgery: needs the PoW over the tagged miniblock
mining with another member's tag: credits that member, not the attacker
proof replay: one proof per height
griefing by never anchoring: anyone (a member) anchors; unanchored blocks are simply not credited
stake-only weight: stake without verified work earns nothing
dominant miner: share cap per epoch
reorg within the reorg limit reverts the anchor with the block (honest limit)
tag 00000000 squatting (stock miners leave Flags 0): tags 00000000/ffffffff refused
shifted parse with a chosen miniblock count: the count is fixed (10)
late claim after Rollover: claims close when Rollover opens
per-identity cap split by Sybils at the entry fee each: stated, the cap only limits one dominant identity

mechanisms.name: discovery beacon
mechanisms.equilibrium: pull-only discovery (D-GT-22): the owner publishes measured figures with height ranges; users opt in
mechanisms.observable: GetSC: nameHdr, descrHdr, v_<k>, r_<k>, h_<k>, nsub
mechanisms.sustainability: the owner pays the fee per Publish; holds no DERO
attacks: misleading figures: each must carry a height range and be reproducible (OR-4); future ranges refused
spam subscriptions: cost the subscriber a fee, harm nobody
